title: M4-RAG: A Massive-Scale Multilingual Multi-Cultural Multimodal RAG

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing visual question answering (VQA) accuracy across 42 languages and 56 dialects by evaluating performance differences when models are given prompts and retrieved contexts in English versus translated target languages, specifically measuring degradation for low-resource languages.

Evaluating model performance on culturally grounded datasets (WorldCuisines and CVQA) to determine if models struggle to integrate non-English cultural evidence, revealing an English-centric reasoning pivot even for culture-specific queries.
